muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿هنالك الولاية لله الحق﴾: (هنالك) is a demonstrative in the position of accusative (naṣb) as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الولاية) is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the sense contained in the demonstrative, or to what it is attached to, namely the omitted khabar, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الولاية); and (الحق) is an adjective of (لله). Or the demonstrative is attached to the sense of settledness in ﴿لله﴾, (الولاية) is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar, i.e. "settled for Allah"; or they are attached to (الولاية) itself, since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning "support".
﴿هو خير ثوابا وخير عقبا﴾: (هو) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), (خير) the khabar (predicate), and (ثوابًا) a tamyīz (specification); ﴿وخير عقبًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خير ثوابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿واضرب لهم مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء أنزلناه من السماء﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (اضرب) is an imperative verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اضرب﴾; ﴿مثل الحياة الدنيا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿كماء﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿ماء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أنزلناه من السماء﴾ is an adjective of (ماء). Or ﴿اضرب﴾ means "mention", so it takes a single object, and the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a striking like that of water".
﴿فاختلط به نبات الأرض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (اختلط) is a past verb; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اختلط﴾; and (نبات الأرض) is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فأصبح هشيما تذروه الرياح﴾: (فأصبح) is conjoined to (اختلط); the noun of (أصبح) is latent (mustatir), referring back to (نبات الأرض); (هشيمًا) is the khabar of (أصبح); and the clause ﴿تذروه الرياح﴾ is an adjective of His words (هشيمًا).
﴿وكان الله على كل شيء مقتدرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the Divine Name is the noun of (كان); (مقتدرًا) is the khabar of (كان); and ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مقتدرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿المال والبنون زينة الحياة الدنيا﴾: (المال) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (البنون) is conjoined to (المال); (زينة) is the khabar (predicate); (الحياة) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (الدنيا) is an adjective.
﴿والباقيات الصالحات خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير أملا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (الباقيات) is a mubtadaʾ; (الصالحات) an adjective; (خير) the khabar of (الباقيات); ﴿عند ربك﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ثوابًا) is a tamyīz (specification); and ﴿وخير أملًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خير ثوابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ويوم نسير الجبال﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿يوم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; (نسير) is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "We"; (الجبال) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿نسير﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وترى الأرض بارزة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ترى) is an imperfect verb; the fāʿil of (ترى) is latent, implied as "you"; (الأرض) is a mafʿūl bihi; (بارزة) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the preceding one.
﴿وحشرناهم فلم نغادر منهم أحدا﴾: the wāw here is circumstantial; (حشرناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "We carry out the moving [of the mountains] while gathering them, so that they witness those terrors with their own eyes"; or the wāw is conjunctive and the past tense is meant as future, i.e. "and We shall gather them". In ﴿فلم﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (نغادر) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, its fāʿil latent, implied as "We"; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, because it was [originally] an adjective of ﴿أحدًا﴾; and (أحدًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وعرضوا على ربك صفا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, joining to ﴿وحشرناهم﴾; (عرضوا) is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿على ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عرضوا﴾; and (صفًّا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the plural wāw in ﴿عرضوا﴾.
﴿لقد جئتمونا كما خلقناكم أول مرة﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئتمونا) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿كما﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or as a ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause has no grammatical position; ﴿أول مرة﴾ is accusative as an adverb, attached to ﴿خلقناكم﴾; and the clause ﴿لقد جئتمونا﴾ is circumstantial, or the object of an omitted "saying" (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل زعمتم ألن نجعل لكم موعدا﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (زعمتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أن) is lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (نجعل) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "We"; the clause ﴿لن نجعل...﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (أن); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, and (موعدًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نجعل﴾; or ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجعل﴾, taking (نجعل) in the sense of bringing into existence, and (موعدًا) is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ألن نجعل لكم﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿زعمتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ووضع الكتاب فترى المجرمين مشفقين مما فيه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (وضع) is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and (الكتاب) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); in ﴿فترى﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (ترى) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (المجرمين) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and (مشفقين) the second mafʿūl bihi, the seeing here being cognitive; or the seeing is visual and ﴿مشفقين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مشفقين﴾; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [element forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ويقولون يا ويلتنا مال هذا الكتاب لا يغادر صغيرة ولا كبيرة إلا أحصاها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and (يقولون) is conjoined; (يا) is a vocative particle and (ويلتنا) is the one addressed (munādā); ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); (الكتاب) is a badal (substitute); the clause ﴿لا يغادر﴾ is circumstantial; (صغيرة) is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ولا كبيرة﴾ is conjoined to (صغيرة); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the clause ﴿أحصاها﴾ is an adjective of ﴿صغيرة﴾, or a second object of ﴿يغادر﴾, because it means "leave" and takes two objects.
﴿ووجدوا ما عملوا حاضرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (وجدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause (عملوا) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "they found their deeds"; and (حاضرًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا يظلم ربك أحدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يظلم﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿ربك﴾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿أحدا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (للملائكة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قلنا); (اسجدوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لآدم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (اسجدوا); (فسجدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إلا) is a particle of exception; (إبليس) is the excepted (mustathnā); and the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ), and it is said: joined (muttaṣil).
﴿كان من الجن ففسق عن أمر ربه﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), implied as ﴿هو﴾, referring back to Iblīs; (من الجن) is the khabar (predicate); (ففسق) is conjoined to (كان); and (عن أمر ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (فسق).
﴿أفتتخذونه وذريته أولياء من دوني وهم لكم عدو بئس للظالمين بدلا﴾: the hamza is interrogative. (تتخذونه): an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وذريته﴾: the wāw is conjunctive. (ذريته): conjoined to the hāʾ; or the wāw means "with", and (ذريته) is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). (أولياء): a second mafʿūl bihi. (من دوني): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of (أولياء), or attached to ﴿تتخذونه﴾. ﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. (هم): mubtadaʾ (subject). (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was [originally] an adjective of (عدو). (عدو): khabar of ﴿هم﴾. The clause ﴿هم لكم عدو﴾ is a ḥāl of the object of (تتخذونه) or of its agent. (بئس): a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, its fāʿil a latent pronoun. (للظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. (بدلًا): tamyīz (specification); and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, the implied form being: "How evil a substitute are Iblīs and his offspring".

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ما أشهدتهم خلق السماوات والأرض ولا خلق أنفسهم﴾: (ما) is negative; (أشهدتهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (خلق السماوات والأرض) is a second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿ولا خلق أنفسهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾.
﴿وما كنت متخذ المضلين عضدا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; in ﴿كنت﴾, (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and the tāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of (كان); (متخذ) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); (المضلين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (عضدًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿متخذ﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ويوم يقول نادوا شركائي الذين زعمتم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿يوم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (نادوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (شركائي) is a mafʿūl bihi; (الذين) is a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿زعمتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "whom you claimed to be partners", just as the second object of (زعمتم) is also omitted.
﴿فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم وجعلنا بينهم موبقا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (دعوهم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فلم﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (يستجيبوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستجيبوا﴾; (جعلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بينهم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted second object; and ﴿موبقًا﴾ is the first object.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ورأى المجرمون النار﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فظنوا أنهم مواقعوها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (ظنوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿هم﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); (مواقعوها) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause stands in place of the two objects of ﴿ظنوا﴾.
﴿ولم يجدوا عنها مصرفا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (لم يجدوا) is conjoined to (ظنوا); ﴿عنها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مصرفًا﴾; and (مصرفًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرآن للناس من كل مثل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (صرفنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صرفنا﴾; (القرآن) is a badal (substitute) of ﴿هذا﴾; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صرفنا﴾; ﴿من كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted qualified noun, which is the object of ﴿صرفنا﴾, i.e. "a strange, wondrous meaning which resembles a parable (mathal) in its strangeness and novelty"; and ﴿مثل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الإنسان) is the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿أكثر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); ﴿شيء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿جدلًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وما منع الناس أن يؤمنوا إذ جاءهم الهدى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; (منع) is a past verb; (الناس) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يؤمنوا﴾ is the second object of ﴿منع﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منع﴾ or to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾; and the clause ﴿جاءهم الهدى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ويستغفروا ربهم إلا أن تأتيهم سنة الأولين أو يأتيهم العذاب قبلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (يستغفروا) is conjoined to (يؤمنوا), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ربهم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن) and what falls within its scope is the fāʿil of (منع); (تأتيهم) is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (سنة الأولين) is a delayed fāʿil; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; (يأتيهم العذاب) is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم سنة الأولين﴾; ﴿قبلًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun or of (العذاب); and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed before ﴿أن تأتيهم سنة الأولين﴾, its implied form being "waiting for the coming", since the coming of the way [dealt with] the ancients cannot be made the thing that prevented them from believing.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وما نرسل المرسلين إلا مبشرين ومنذرين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; (نرسل) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); (المرسلين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (مبشرين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and (منذرين) is conjoined.
﴿ويجادل الذين كفروا بالباطل ليدحضوا به الحق﴾: (يجادل) is an imperfect verb; (الذين) is the fāʿil; (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; ﴿بالباطل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾; in ﴿ليدحضوا﴾ the lām is causal, and (يدحضوا) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿يجادل﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدحضوا﴾; and (الحق) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واتخذوا آياتي وما أنذروا هزوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (اتخذوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (آياتي) is the first mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined to ﴿آياتي﴾, and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya and the maṣdar is conjoined to (آياتي); and (هزوًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن ذكر بآيات ربه فأعرض عنها ونسي ما قدمت يداه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن) is an interrogative noun with the meaning of negation, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم) is the khabar (predicate); (ممن) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أظلم); the clause ﴿ذكر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾ with no grammatical position; (بآيات ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ذكر); the clause ﴿ومَن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (فأعرض) is conjoined to (ذكر), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; (عنها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أعرض); (نسي) is conjoined to what precedes; (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; and (يداه) is the fāʿil.
﴿إنا جعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is the khabar of (إن); (على قلوبهم) is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of (جعلنا); (أكنة) is the first mafʿūl bihi; (أن) is a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle; (يفقهوه) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb), the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يفقهوه﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and ﴿في آذانهم وقرًا﴾ is conjoined to the two governed elements of (جعلنا).
﴿وإن تدعهم إلى الهدى فلن يهتدوا إذا أبدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تدعهم) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent, implied as "you", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; (إلى الهدى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تدعهم); (فلن): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (يهتدوا) is accusative by (لن), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إذًا) is a particle of answer and requital; and (أبدًا) is an adverb attached to (يهتدوا).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وربك الغفور ذو الرحمة لو يؤاخذهم بما كسبوا لعجل لهم العذاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ربك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الغفور) is the khabar (predicate); (ذو الرحمة) is a second khabar; the clause ﴿وربك الغفور﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (لو) is conditional; (يؤاخذهم) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤاخذهم﴾; the clause (كسبوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; the lām is connective (rābiṭa); (عجل) is a past verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عجل﴾; and (العذاب) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بل لهم موعد لن يجدوا من دونه موئلا﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿لهم﴾ is a fronted khabar; (موعد) is a delayed mubtadaʾ; (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (يجدوا) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (موئلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وتلك القرى أهلكناهم لما ظلموا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿تلك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), or accusative by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb); (القرى) is a badal (substitute), and the clause (أهلكناهم) is the khabar (predicate); or ﴿القرى﴾ is the khabar, and the clause (أهلكناهم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar; ﴿لما﴾ is an adverb meaning "when", attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكناهم﴾; and the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿وجعلنا لمهلكهم موعدا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (جعلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لمهلكهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or attached to ﴿موعدًا﴾; (مهلكهم) is a mīm-maṣdar (verbal noun with prefixed mīm) put in construct with its agent; and (موعدًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وإذ قال موسى لفتاه لا أبرح حتى أبلغ مجمع البحرين أو أمضي حقبا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "mention"; ﴿قال موسى﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿قال موسى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لفتاه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; (لا) is negative; (أبرح) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun latent (mustatir), implied as "I", and its khabar (predicate) omitted, implied as "[I keep] travelling"; or ﴿أبرح﴾ is complete (tāmm) and so requires no khabar, i.e. "I will not leave off the travelling and seeking I am engaged in, nor part from it"; ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and genitive; (أبلغ) is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after (حتى), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition with its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أبرح﴾; (مجمع البحرين) is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿أمضي﴾ is conjoined to (أبلغ); and ﴿حقبًا﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿أمضي﴾.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فلما بلغا مجمع بينهما نسيا حوتهما فاتخذ سبيله في البحر سربا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لما) is an adverb meaning "when"; the clause ﴿بلغا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); (مجمع) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb put in construct with ﴿مجمع﴾; the clause ﴿نسيا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (لما); (حوتهما) is a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فاتخذ﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (اتخذ) is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "it", i.e. the fish; ﴿سبيله﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and (سربًا) the second mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿فلما جاوزا قال لفتاه آتنا غداءنا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لما) is an adverb of time meaning "when"; the clause (جاوزا) is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it, and the object is omitted, i.e. "they passed beyond the place where they had forgotten the fish"; the clause ﴿قال لفتاه﴾ has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿آتنا غداءنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and (غداءنا) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿آتنا﴾.
﴿لقد لقينا من سفرنا هذا نصبا﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (لقينا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من سفرنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لقينا﴾; ﴿هذا﴾ is an adjective of ﴿سفرنا﴾ or a badal (substitute) of it; and ﴿نصبًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿لقينا﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال أرأيت إذ أوينا إلى الصخرة﴾: (أرأيت): the hamza is interrogative, and (رأيت) is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, the tāʾ being the fāʿil (agent); the two objects of (أرأيت) are omitted for brevity, i.e. "Have you considered our affair, what its outcome is?"; the clause (أوينا) is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; and (إلى الصخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوينا﴾.
﴿فإني نسيت الحوت﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason for the astonishment that came over them from what had befallen them; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); and the clause ﴿نسيت الحوت﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن).
﴿وما أنسانيه إلا الشيطان أن أذكره﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical between the conjoined element and what it is conjoined to, with no grammatical position; (ما) is negative; (أنسانيه) is a past verb, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the hāʾ the second mafʿūl bihi; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الشيطان) is the fāʿil of (أنسانيه); and (أن) with what falls within its scope is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of the hāʾ, i.e. "and none made me forget to mention it but Satan".
﴿واتخذ سبيله في البحر عجبا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (اتخذ) is a past verb conjoined to (نسيت), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "it", i.e. the fish; ﴿سبيله﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عجبا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿اتخذ﴾; ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اتخذ﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the first or second object; or ﴿عجبا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and ﴿في البحر﴾ is attached to an omitted second object of ﴿اتخذ﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قال ذلك ما كنا نبغ﴾: (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (ما) is the khabar (predicate); (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of (كان); the clause ﴿نبغي﴾ is the khabar of (كان); the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ذلك...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فارتدا على آثارهما قصصا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (ارتدا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على آثارهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ارتدا﴾; and ﴿قصصا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "retracing [their steps] a retracing", or a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "so they went back on their tracks, retracing".

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿فوجدا عبدا من عبادنا آتيناه رحمة من عندنا وعلمناه من لدنا علما﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿وجدا عبدًا﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من عبادنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿عبدًا﴾; the clause ﴿آتيناه﴾ is a second adjective; (رحمة) is a second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من عندنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿رحمة﴾; (علمناه) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من لدنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿علمًا﴾ and was placed before it; and (علمًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿علمناه﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿قال له موسى هل أتبعك على أن تعلمن مما علمت رشدا﴾: (قال) is a past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; (موسى) is the fāʿil (agent); (هل) is an interrogative particle; (أتبعك) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن تعلمني﴾: (أن) with what falls within its scope is in the position of genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in ﴿أتبعك﴾, i.e. "may I follow you, you being my teacher?"; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تعلمني﴾; the clause (علمت) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; and (رشدًا) is the second object of ﴿تعلمني﴾, since the yāʾ is the first object; or it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of right guidance"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿قال إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the kāf is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (تستطيع) is accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; the clause ﴿لن تستطيع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); ﴿معي﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "you being with me"; (صبرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿إنك...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وكيف تصبر على ما لم تحط به خبرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (تصبر) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تصبر﴾; the clause ﴿لم تحط﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تحط﴾; and ﴿خبرا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because (لم تحط) means "you have not had knowledge (lam takhbur)", or it is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent, i.e. "your knowledge has not encompassed it".

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿قال ستجدني إن شاء الله صابرا ولا أعصي لك أمرا﴾: ﴿ستجدني﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; (تجدني) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you", and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إن شاء الله﴾ is a parenthetical clause, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His words ﴿تجدني﴾. (صابرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تجدني﴾; the clause ﴿ولا أعصي لك أمرًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿صابرًا﴾ and so is in the position of accusative, or conjoined to ﴿ستجدني﴾; and ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿أمرًا﴾ and was placed before it.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿قال فإن اتبعتني فلا تسألني عن شيء حتى أحدث لك منه ذكرا﴾: in ﴿فإن﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive and (إن) is conditional; (اتبعتني) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); (لا) is prohibitive; (تسألني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عن شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسألني﴾; (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (أحدث) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after (حتى), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition with its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تسألني﴾; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحدث﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ذكرًا﴾; (ذكرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and an omitted adjective must be supposed after ﴿شيء﴾, i.e. "a thing whose secret is hidden from you".

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا ركبا في السفينة خرقها﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿انطلقا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb of past time containing the sense of a condition; the clause ﴿ركبا في السفينة﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (خرقها) is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿خرقها﴾ is the answer of (إذا).
﴿قال أخرقتها لتغرق أهلها لقد جئت شيئا إمرا﴾: in ﴿أخرقتها﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and (خرقتها) is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿لتغرق﴾ the lām is causal, and (تغرق) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خرقتها﴾; (أهلها) is a mafʿūl bihi; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (إمرًا) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿قال ألم أقل إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: in ﴿ألم﴾ the hamza is interrogative and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; ﴿أقل﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; in ﴿إنك﴾, (إن) [is the particle] and the kāf its noun; (لن) is a particle of negation and accusative; (تستطيع) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, the sign of its accusative being the overt fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; ﴿معي﴾ is an adverb in the accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "you being with me", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صبرا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿لن تستطيع معي صبرًا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿قال لا تؤاخذني بما نسيت ولا ترهقني من أمري عسرا﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تؤاخذني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you", and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تؤاخذني﴾; ﴿نسيت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; ﴿من أمري﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿عسرًا﴾; and (عسرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ترهقني﴾.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا لقيا غلاما فقتله﴾: the fāʾ is for conjunction; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb of past time containing the sense of a condition; ﴿لقيا﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) [Translator's note: so in the source; إذا does not make its verb jussive, and the source itself goes on to say the clause is in the position of genitive], and the clause is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (غلامًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; and the clause ﴿فقتله﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لقيا﴾.
﴿قال أقتلت نفسا زكية بغير نفس لقد جئت شيئا نكرا﴾: the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the answer of (إذا); in ﴿أقتلت﴾ the hamza is interrogative and (قتلت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (نفسًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (زكية) is an adjective; ﴿بغير نفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent, i.e. "you killed him unjustly", or of the object, i.e. "you killed him, he being wronged", or attached to ﴿قتلت﴾; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (جئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (شيئًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (نكرًا) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿قال ألم أقل لك إنك لن تستطيع معي صبرا﴾: (ألم): the hamza is interrogative and (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (أقل): an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ﴿أقل﴾; (إنك): (إن) [is the particle] and the kāf its noun; (لن) is a particle of negation and accusative; (تستطيع) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by (لن), the sign of its accusative being the overt fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (معي) is an adverb in the accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to something omitted, i.e. "you being with me", and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (صبرا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿لن تستطيع معي صبرًا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿قال إن سألتك عن شيء بعدها فلا تصاحبني﴾: (إن) is conditional; (سألتك) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عن شيء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سألتك﴾; (بعدها) is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of (شيء); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is prohibitive; (تصاحبني) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قد بلغت من لدني عذرا﴾: (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (بلغت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (من) is a preposition; (لدن) is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿بلغت﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿عذرًا﴾; and ﴿عذرًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فانطلقا حتى إذا أتيا أهل قرية استطعما أهلها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (انطلقا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing the sense of a condition; (أتيا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أهل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and (قرية) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿استطعما أهلها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (إذا); and it is said: the clause ﴿استطعما أهلها﴾ is an adjective of (قرية).
﴿فأبوا أن يضيفوهما﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿أبوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; and (أن) with what falls within its scope is the object of (أبوا).
﴿فوجدا فيها جدارا يريد أن ينقض فأقامه﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (وجدا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وجدا﴾; (جدارًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is an adjective of ﴿جدارًا﴾; and (أن) with what falls within its scope is the object of (يريد). ﴿فأقامه﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and (أقامه) is a verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قال لو شئت لاتخذت عليه أجرا﴾: (لو) is a non-jussive conditional particle; (شئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; the lām occurs in the answer of (لو); (اتخذت) is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿لاتخذت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (لو); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (أجرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿قال هذا فراق بيني وبينك﴾: (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (فراق) is the khabar (predicate); (بيني) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (بينك) is conjoined to (بيني).
﴿سأنبئك بتأويل ما لم تستطع عليه صبرا﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; (أنبئك) is a verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بتأويل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سأنبئك﴾; (ما) is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (تستطع) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (صبرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صبرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿أما السفينة فكانت لمساكين يعملون في البحر﴾: (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (السفينة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); (كانت): (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "it [fem.]", and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; (لمساكين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (كان); the clause ﴿فكانت لمساكين﴾ is the khabar of (السفينة); the clause ﴿يعملون في البحر﴾ is an adjective of (مساكين); and (في البحر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يعملون﴾.
﴿فأردت أن أعيبها وكان وراءهم ملك يأخذ كل سفينة غصبا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (أردت) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن أعيبها﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of (أردت); the wāw is circumstantial; (كان) is an incomplete past verb; (وراءهم) is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ملك) is the delayed noun of (كان); the clause ﴿يأخذ﴾ is an adjective; (كل) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and (سفينة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (غصبًا) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or is a maṣdar in the place of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وأما الغلام فكان أبواه مؤمنين فخشينا أن يرهقهما طغيانا وكفرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (الغلام) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (فكان): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (أبواه) is the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is a dual; and (مؤمنين) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a dual. (فخشينا): the fāʾ is conjunctive, and (خشينا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أن) with what falls within its scope is the object of (خشينا); (طغيانًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كفرًا) is conjoined to (طغيانًا); and the answer clause is the khabar of (الغلام).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿فأردنا أن يبدلهما ربهما خيرا منه زكاة وأقرب رحما﴾: (فأردنا) is conjoined to (خشينا), and (أردنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أن يبدلهما): (أن) with what falls within its scope is the object of (أردنا); (يبدلهما) is a verb and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ربهما﴾ is a delayed fāʿil, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (خيرًا منه) is the second object; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خيرًا﴾; (زكاة) is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿وأقرب رحمًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خيرًا منه زكاة﴾; and (رحمًا) is a tamyīz or a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿وأما الجدار فكان لغلامين يتيمين في المدينة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (الجدار) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (فكان): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), implied as "it"; (لغلامين) is a preposition and its genitive noun […] the khabar (predicate) of (كان) [Translator's note: the source has a stray letter «ر» here; presumably the words "attached to an omitted" have dropped out]; (يتيمين) is an adjective of (غلامين); ﴿في المدينة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second adjective or ḥāl (circumstantial); and the answer clause ﴿فكان ...﴾ is the khabar of (الجدار).
﴿وكان تحته كنز لهما وكان أبوهما صالحا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (كان) is an incomplete past verb; (تحته) is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (كنز) is its delayed noun; and ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective. ﴿وكان أبوهما صالحا﴾: (كان) is an incomplete past verb; (أبو) is the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns; ﴿هما﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (صالحا) is the khabar of (كان), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿فأراد ربك أن يبلغا أشدهما ويستخرجا كنزهما رحمة من ربك﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (أراد) is a past verb; (ربك) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن يبلغا﴾ is the object of (أراد); (أشدهما) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يبلغا﴾; (يستخرجا) is conjoined to (يبلغا), and the alif is the fāʿil; (كنزهما) is a mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿رحمة من ربك﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿وما فعلته عن أمري ذلك تأويل ما لم تسطع عليه صبرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (ما) is negative; (فعلته) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; (عن أمري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "issuing from my own command"; (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ; (تأويل) is the khabar; (ما) is muḍāf ilayhi; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [to past] and jussive; (تسطع) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صبرًا﴾; and (صبرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿ويسألونك عن ذي القرنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (يسألونك) is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and in ﴿عن ذي القرنين﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسألونك﴾.
﴿قل سأتلو عليكم منه ذكرا﴾: the clause (سأتلو) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أتلو﴾; (منه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿ذكرًا﴾ and was placed before it; and (ذكرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿إنا مكنا له في الأرض وآتيناه من كل شيء سببا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause ﴿مكَّنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكَّنا﴾; (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to ﴿مكَّنا﴾; (آتيناه) is conjoined to (مكَّنا), and it is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿من كل شيء﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿سببًا﴾ and was placed before it; and (سببًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi of (آتيناه).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿فأتبع سببا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (أتبع) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; and (سببًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). It is also said: the verb (أتبع) takes two objects, one of which is omitted, the implied form being "so he made one means follow another means", or "so he made his affair follow a means".

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿حتى إذا بلغ مغرب الشمس وجدها تغرب في عين حمئة﴾: (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing the sense of a condition; the clause ﴿بلغ﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (مغرب الشمس) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وجدها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; (في عين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تغرب﴾; and (حمئة) is an adjective of (عين).
﴿ووجد عندها قوما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (وجد) is conjoined to (وجدها); (عندها) is an adverb attached to ﴿وجد﴾; and (قومًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قلنا يا ذا القرنين إما أن تعذب وإما أن تتخذ فيهم حسنا﴾: (قلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ذا القرنين) is the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf); (إما) is a particle of condition and detailing [Translator's note: so in the source]; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن تعذب﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is your punishing", or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "either your punishing takes place", or the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. "either you carry out the punishing". ﴿وإما أن تتخذ﴾ is conjoined to (إما أن تعذب); ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تتخذ﴾, or attached to an omitted second object of (تتخذ); and (حسنًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿قال أما من ظلم فسوف نعذبه﴾: (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (من) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿ظلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿فسوف﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) and (سوف) is a particle of the future; (نعذبه) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and an object; and the clause ﴿سوف نعذبه﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (من).
﴿ثم يرد إلى ربه فيعذبه عذابا نكرا﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction of [sequence with] delay; (يرد) is an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, implied as "he"; ﴿إلى ربه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرد﴾; (فيعذبه): the fāʾ is conjunctive, and (يعذبه) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عذابا) stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and (نكرًا) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿وأما من آمن وعمل صالحا فله جزاء الحسنى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (أما) is a particle of condition and detailing; (من) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; (عمل) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; (صالحا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "he did a righteous deed". ﴿فله﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and ﴿له﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate); (جزاء) is a tamyīz (specification), or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being recompensed"; and it is said: it is accusative as a maṣdar, i.e. "he will be recompensed with a recompense"; and (الحسنى) is a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿وسنقول له من أمرنا يسرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (سنقول) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil a latent pronoun, implied as "We"; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقول﴾; (من أمرنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was an adjective of ﴿يسرًا﴾ and was placed before it; and (يسرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi, or stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a saying of ease".

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿ثم أتبع سببا﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction; (أتبع) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; and (سببًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). It is also said: the verb (أتبع) takes two objects, one of which is omitted, the implied form being "so (فأتبع) he made one means follow another means", or "so he made his affair follow a means". [Translator's note: the implied forms begin with «فأتبع», carried over from the parsing of ayah 85; this ayah reads ﴿ثم أتبع﴾.]

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿حتى إذا بلغ مطلع الشمس وجدها تطلع على قوم لم نجعل لهم من دونها سترا﴾: (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing the sense of a condition; the clause ﴿بلغ﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; the clause ﴿وجدها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿تطلع﴾ is the second object of ﴿وجدها﴾; (على قوم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تطلع﴾; the clause ﴿لم نجعل﴾ is an adjective of (قوم); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted, in the place of accusative as the second object of (نجعل); ﴿من دونها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (سترًا) is the first object of (نجعل).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿كذلك وقد أحطنا بما لديه خبرا﴾: (كذلك) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter is thus". (وقد): the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial, and (قد) is a particle of affirmation; (أحطنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحطنا﴾; and (لديه) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: so in the source; the words "mafʿūl bihi" stand without their subject, and presumably something like "and (خبرا) is a tamyīz / …" has dropped out.]

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿ثم أتبع سببا﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction; (أتبع) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; and (سببًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). It is also said: the verb (أتبع) takes two objects, one of which is omitted, the implied form being "so (فأتبع) he made one means follow another means", or "so he made his affair follow a means". [Translator's note: the implied forms begin with «فأتبع», carried over from the parsing of ayah 85; this ayah reads ﴿ثم أتبع﴾.]

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿حتى إذا بلغ بين السدين وجد من دونهما قوما لا يكادون يفقهون قولا﴾: (حتى): a particle of limit and genitive. (إذا): an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وجد﴾; the clause ﴿بلغ﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it. (بين): a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or an adverb attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted object, i.e. "a place lying between the two barriers"; (السدين) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿وجد﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; (من دونهما) is the second object of (وجد), and (قومًا) the first object of (وجد); (لا) is negative; (يكادون) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the noun of (يكاد); the clause ﴿يفقهون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (يكاد); (قولًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿لا يكادون﴾ is an adjective of (قومًا).

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿قالوا يا ذا القرنين إن يأجوج ومأجوج مفسدون في الأرض﴾: ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; (ذا القرنين) is the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; (يأجوج) is the noun of (إن), accusative (manṣūb); (مأجوج) is conjoined to (يأجوج); (مفسدون) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مفسدون﴾.
﴿فهل نجعل لك خرجا على أن تجعل بيننا وبينهم سدا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (هل) is an interrogative particle; (نجعل) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted second object of (نجعل); (خرجًا) is the first object of (نجعل); ﴿على أن تجعل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿خرجًا﴾, i.e. "resting on this condition"; ﴿بيننا﴾ is an adverb attached to the omitted second object of (تجعل); ﴿بينهم﴾ is conjoined to (بيننا); and (سدًّا) is the first object of (تجعل).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿قال ما مكني فيه ربي خير﴾: (ما) is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿مكني﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ with no grammatical position; (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكني﴾; (ربي) is the fāʿil (agent) of (مكني); and (خير) is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿فأعينوني بقوة أجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (أعينوني) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بقوة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعينوني﴾; (أجعل) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request; (بينكم) is an adverb attached to the second object of (أجعل); (بينهم) is conjoined to it; and (ردمًا) is the first object of (أجعل).

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿آتوني زبر الحديد حتى إذا ساوى بين الصدفين﴾: (آتوني) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (زبر) is the second mafʿūl bihi, and (الحديد) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing [the sense of] a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾ after it; (ساوى) is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿ساوى﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; and (بين الصدفين) is an adverb attached to ﴿ساوى﴾.
﴿قال انفخوا حتى إذا جعله نارا قال آتوني أفرغ عليه قطرا﴾: the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (إذا); the clause ﴿انفخوا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (حتى) is a particle of limit and genitive; (إذا) is an adverb that occurs here for past time, containing [the sense of] a condition, attached to ﴿قال﴾ after it; the clause ﴿جعله نارًا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (نارًا) is the second object of (جعل); the clause ﴿آتوني﴾ is the object of the saying; (أفرغ) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request, its fāʿil being "I"; (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أفرغ﴾; and (قطرًا) is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أفرغ﴾. The implied form is: "Bring me molten copper, that I may pour molten copper upon it", the first being omitted because the second indicates it. The case belongs to the chapter of tanāzuʿ (two governors contending for one governed word): the second [verb] has been made to govern; had the first been made to govern, it would have said «آتوني أفرغه عليه قطرًا», since the implied form [then] is «آتوني قطرًا أفرغه عليه».

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿فما اسطاعوا أن يظهروه وما استطاعوا له نقبا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, joining to something omitted, i.e. "then the people of Gog came, after he had finished building and levelling it, trying to climb over it or pierce it, but they were not able". ﴿ما﴾ is negative; (اسطاعوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it is the object of ﴿اسطاعوا﴾. ﴿وما استطاعوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فما اسطاعوا﴾; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقبًا﴾; and (نقبًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿قال هذا رحمة من ربي﴾: the clause ﴿هذا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (رحمة) the khabar (predicate), the reference being to the barrier; and (من ربي) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of (رحمة).
﴿فإذا جاء وعد ربي جعله دكاء﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (إذا) is a future adverb; the clause ﴿جاء وعد ربي﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; the clause ﴿جعله﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; (دكاء) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعل﴾; and the clause ﴿فإذا جاء وعد...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان وعد ربي حقا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (وعد) is the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ); and ﴿حقًّا﴾ is the khabar of (كان), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿وتركنا بعضهم يومئذ يموج في بعض﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (تركنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (بعضهم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿يومئذ﴾, (يوم) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾, and (إذٍ) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being "on the day when the promise of my Lord came"; the clause ﴿يموج في بعض﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of (تركنا); and the tanwīn in ﴿إذ﴾ compensates for a clause. It is also said that ﴿ترك﴾ is transitive to a single object, in which case the clause ﴿يموج﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ونفخ في الصور فجمعناهم جمعا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (نفخ) is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); (في الصور) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نفخ﴾; (فجمعناهم): the fāʾ is conjunctive, and (جمعناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and (جمعًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿وعرضنا جهنم يومئذ للكافرين عرضا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (عرضنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (جهنم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿يومئذ﴾, (يوم) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عرضنا﴾, and (إذٍ) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the tanwīn compensating for an omitted clause, the implied form being "on the day when We gathered the creatures"; (للكافرين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿عرضنا﴾; and (عرضًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:101-101.t: ﴿الذين كانت أعينهم في غطاء عن ذكري وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا﴾: (الذين) is an adjective of (الكافرين) or a badal (substitute) of them; the clause ﴿كانت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (أعينهم) is the noun of (كانت); (في غطاء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (كانت); (عن ذكري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of (غطاء); (كانوا): (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and the plural wāw is the noun of (كان); and the clause ﴿لا يستطيعون سمعًا﴾ is the khabar of (كان).

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿أفحسب الذين كفروا أن يتخذوا عبادي من دوني أولياء﴾: the hamza is interrogative; (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; (أن) with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of (حسب); (يتخذوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (عبادي) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ of the speaker is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من دوني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أولياء); and (أولياء) is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنا أعتدنا جهنم للكافرين نزلا﴾: (إنا): (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause ﴿أعتدنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (جهنم) is a mafʿūl bihi; (للكافرين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of (نزلًا); and (نزلًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi or a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿قل هل ننبئكم بالأخسرين أعمالا﴾: (قل) is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; (هل) is interrogative; (ننبئكم) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma, its fāʿil latent, implied as "We", and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿هل ننبئكم﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (بالأخسرين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ننبئكم﴾; and (أعمالًا) is a tamyīz (specification). The tamyīz is in the plural, though it is properly singular, to match the specified word (al-mumayyaz), or because their deeds in error differ and they do not share in one single deed.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿الذين ضل سعيهم في الحياة الدنيا وهم يحسبون أنهم يحسنون صنعا﴾: (الذين) is a relative noun, an adjective of (الأخسرين), or a badal (substitute), or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), as though it were the answer to someone asking: "And who are the greatest losers in deeds?"; the clause ﴿ضل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; (سعيهم) is the fāʿil (agent); (في الحياة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضل﴾; (الدنيا) is an adjective; the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يحسبون﴾ is the khabar; (أن) with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of (يحسبون); the clause ﴿يحسنون﴾ is the khabar of (أن); (صنعًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) or a tamyīz (specification); and the clause ﴿وهم يحسبون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (سعيهم).

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿أولئك الذين كفروا بآيات ربهم ولقائه فحبطت أعمالهم﴾: (أولئك) is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين) is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; ﴿بآيات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفروا﴾; ﴿ربهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لقائه) is conjoined to (آيات); ﴿فحبطت﴾ is conjoined to (كفروا); and (أعمالهم) is the fāʿil (agent) of (حبطت).
﴿فلا نقيم لهم يوم القيامة وزنا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; (لا) is negative; (نقيم) is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "We"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نقيم﴾; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb also attached to ﴿نقيم﴾; (القيامة) is muḍāf ilayhi; and (وزنًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿ذلك جزاؤهم جهنم بما كفروا﴾:
(ذلك): a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (جزاؤهم): khabar (predicate); (جهنم): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of His words ﴿جزاؤهم﴾.
Or (ذلك): the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is that", and ﴿جزاؤهم جهنم﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar.
Or (ذلك): a mubtadaʾ; (جزاؤهم): a second mubtadaʾ; (جهنم): the khabar of (جزاؤهم); and the clause ﴿جزاؤهم جهنم﴾ is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ ﴿ذلك﴾.
Or (ذلك): a mubtadaʾ; (جزاؤهم): a badal or ʿaṭf bayān; (جهنم): khabar.
﴿بما كفروا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿كفروا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and its ṣila is genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of their disbelief"; and the bāʾ with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (جزاؤهم), i.e. "established because of their disbelief", or attached to a maṣdar, its implied form being "recompense".
It is also permissible that ﴿ذلك﴾ be a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿جزاؤهم جهنم﴾ a parenthetical clause with no grammatical position, so that the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بما كفروا﴾ are attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾. Or (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ, (جزاؤهم) a badal or ʿaṭf bayān, and (جهنم) the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is Hell"; so that the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿بما كفروا﴾ are attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾.
﴿واتخذوا آياتي ورسلي هزوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; (اتخذوا): conjoined to (كفروا); (آياتي): the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (رسلي): conjoined to (آياتي); (هزوًا): the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t: ﴿إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات كانت لهم جنات الفردوس نزلا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of (إن); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿كانت لهم جنات﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿نزلًا﴾, because it was an adjective of it and was placed before it; ﴿جنات الفردوس﴾ is the noun of (كانت), and (الفردوس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (نزلًا) is the khabar of (كانت). It is also permissible that the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لهم﴾ be the khabar of (كانت), and ﴿نزلًا﴾ a ḥāl of ﴿جنات الفردوس﴾.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t: ﴿خالدين فيها لا يبغون عنها حولا﴾: (خالدين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (لهم); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين); the clause ﴿لا يبغون﴾ is circumstantial; (عنها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿حولًا﴾; and ﴿حولًا﴾ is the object of (يبغون).

muyesser-irab:109-109.t: ﴿قل لو كان البحر مدادا لكلمات ربي لنفد البحر قبل أن تنفد كلمات ربي ولو جئنا بمثله مددا﴾: (لو) is conditional; (كان البحر مدادا): (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, (البحر) the noun of (كان), nominative (marfūʿ), and (مدادًا) the khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); ﴿لكلمات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿مدادًا﴾. ﴿لنفد﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of (لو), and the clause ﴿نفد البحر﴾ is the answer of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position; (قبل) is an adverb attached to ﴿نفد﴾; ﴿أن تنفد﴾: the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the adverb being put in construct with it; (كلمات) is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿ربي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is conjunctive; (لو) is conditional; (جئنا) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the answer of (لو) is omitted, its implied form being "it would be exhausted and they would not be finished"; (بمثله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جئنا﴾; and (مددًا) is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم﴾: (إنما) is [inna] restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أنا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (بشر) is the khabar (predicate); and (مثلكم) is an adjective.
﴿يوحى إلي أنما إلهكم إله واحد﴾: the clause ﴿يوحى﴾ is an adjective of (بشر); (إليَّ) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوحى﴾; (أنما) is restraining and restrained, but it has not left [its] maṣdar-forming function, so it together with what follows is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿إلهكم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿إله﴾ is the khabar; and (واحد) is an adjective.
﴿فمن كان يرجو لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صالحا ولا يشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he", referring back to (من); the clause ﴿يرجو﴾ is its khabar; and (لقاء ربه) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فليعمل﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the lām is the lām of command, and (يعمل) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (عملًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or a mafʿūl bihi; and (صالحًا) is an adjective. The clause ﴿فمن كان يرجو...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (لا يشرك): (لا) is prohibitive, and (يشرك) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the prohibitive (لا); (بعبادة ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يشرك﴾; and (أحدًا) is the object of (يشرك).

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الحمد﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), the implied form being "established for Allah" (ثابت لله).
﴿الذي﴾: naʿt (adjective).
﴿أنزل﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿على عبده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزل﴾.
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولم يجعل له عوجا﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿أنزل﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila, with no grammatical position; or the و is parenthetical, so the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) between the ḥāl (circumstantial) ﴿قيمًا﴾ and the one it describes (ṣāḥibuhā), ﴿الكتاب﴾, with no grammatical position; or the و is circumstantial, so the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from الكتاب.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿قيما﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكتاب, on the view that the clause ﴿ولم يجعل﴾ is parenthetical; or a second ḥāl from الكتاب, on the view that the clause ﴿ولم يجعل﴾ is the first ḥāl; or a single-word badal (substitute) from it; or a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿له﴾; and it is said: accusative by a verb whose implied form is "He made it upright" (جعله قيمًا).
﴿لينذر﴾: the لام is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); ينذر is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; and ينذر takes two objects, the first of which is omitted, its implied form being "the disbelievers" (الكافرين).
﴿بأسًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿شديدًا﴾: adjective (ṣifa).
﴿من لدنه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second adjective, or attached to His words ﴿لينذر﴾.
﴿ويبشر المؤمنين الذين يعملون الصالحات أن لهم أجرا حسنا﴾: the و is a conjunction; يبشر is conjoined to لينذر, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); المؤمنين is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause يعملون الصالحات is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what falls within its scope is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يبشر﴾; and it is said: it is accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿يبشر﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of أن; أجرًا is its postponed noun (ism); and حسنا is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ماكثين﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the هاء in ﴿لهم﴾.
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ماكثين﴾.
﴿أبدًا﴾: an adverb, also attached to ﴿ماكثين﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وينذر الذين قالوا اتخذ الله ولدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ينذر is conjoined to the first ﴿لينذر﴾; الذين is the first object of ينذر, and the second is omitted, namely "the punishment" (البأس), because it was mentioned before; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿اتخذ﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); and ولدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ما لهم به من علم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ما is negating; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علم﴾; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and علم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولا لآبائهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is negating; and لآبائهم is conjoined to ﴿لهم﴾.
﴿كبرت كلمة تخرج من أفواههم إن يقولون إلا كذبا﴾: كبرت is a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm); the تاء is the sign of the feminine; and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هي﴾. ﴿كلمة﴾ is a tamyīz (specification) in the accusative. The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their aforementioned saying" (قولهم المذكور); it is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause before it is its khabar. The clause of blame is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿تخرج﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كلمة﴾; ﴿من أفواههم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخرج﴾; and the fāʿil of ﴿تخرج﴾ is a latent pronoun. إن is negating; ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿كذبًا﴾ is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except a lying saying" (إلا قولًا كذبًا), or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿فلعلك﴾: the فاء is resumptive; لعل is a particle of hope (tarajjī) and of the accusative, one of the sisters of inna; and the كاف is its noun (ism).
﴿باخع﴾: the khabar (predicate) of لعل.
﴿نفسك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿فلعلك باخع...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿على آثارهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿باخع﴾.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿لم يؤمنوا﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿بهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾.
﴿الحديث﴾: a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative.
﴿أسفًا﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the expression of hope.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿إنا جعلنا ما على الأرض زينة لها لنبلوهم أيهم أحسن عملا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of إن; the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلنا, on the view that جعل is in the sense of "making into" (taṣyīr); ﴿على الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; زينة is the second mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) if جعلنا is in the sense of "We created" (خلقنا), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); in ﴿لنبلوهم﴾ the لام is causal, and نبلوهم is accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām, the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعلنا﴾; ﴿أيهم﴾ is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), the هاء is muḍāf ilayhi, أحسن is the khabar, and ﴿عملًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification), the clause being in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ﴿نبلو﴾, because it is in the sense of "We know" (نعلم); or ﴿أي﴾ is relative, in the sense of الذي, and is a badal (substitute) for the هاء in ﴿نبلوهم﴾, the implied form being "that We may test the one who is best" (لنبلو الذي هو أحسن), أحسن being the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "he is best" (هو أحسن), and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وإنا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; and ﴿نا﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن.
﴿لجاعلون﴾: the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and جاعلون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جاعلون﴾.
﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿صعيدًا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جاعلون﴾.
﴿جرزًا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صعيدًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿أم حسبت أن أصحاب الكهف والرقيم كانوا من آياتنا عجبا﴾: أم is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), in the sense of "rather" (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being "Rather, did you think?" (بل أحسبت). حسبت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of حسبت; الرقيم is conjoined to الكهف; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿من آياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and عجبًا is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
