﴿إذ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عجبا﴾ or to ﴿كانوا﴾ in the previous verse; or a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر).
﴿أوى﴾: a past verb.
﴿الفتية﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of أوى; and the clause ﴿أوى الفتية﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إلى الكهف﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوى﴾.
﴿فقالوا﴾: conjoined to أوى.
﴿ربنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā).
﴿آتنا﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "You" (أنت); and ﴿نا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من لدنك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿رحمة﴾ and was placed before it.
﴿رحمة﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وهيئ﴾: conjoined to آتنا.
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هيئ﴾.
﴿من أمرنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿رشدًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿فضربنا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction, and ضربنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿على آذانهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ضربنا; the object of ضربنا is omitted, its implied form being "a veil preventing them from hearing" (حجابًا مانعًا لهم من السماع).
﴿في الكهف﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿سنين﴾: an adverb attached to ﴿ضربنا﴾.
﴿عددًا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of سنين, i.e. "counted" (معدودة) or "of a number" (ذوات عدد).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī).
﴿بعثناهم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لنعلم﴾: the لام is causal (lām al-taʿlīl) or of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba); نعلم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after it; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the لام; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بعثناهم﴾.
﴿أي﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أحصى﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil refers to ﴿أي الحزبين﴾.
﴿لما لبثوا﴾: the لام is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya; لبثوا is a verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and what follows it is genitive by the لام; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أحصى﴾.
﴿أمدًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; and it is said: ﴿أحصى﴾ is an elative noun (ism tafḍīl), so it is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أي﴾, and ﴿أمدًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿نحن نقص عليك نبأهم بالحق﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause نقص is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقص﴾; نبأهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of نقص, or from its object, namely the news, so the باء is for accompaniment (mulābasa).
﴿إنهم فتية آمنوا بربهم وزدناهم هدى﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿هم﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن, and فتية is the khabar of إن; the clause ﴿آمنوا بربهم﴾ is a second khabar, or a naʿt (adjective) of فتية; زدناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; and هدى is the second mafʿūl bihi, or a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وربطنا﴾: conjoined to زدناهم.
﴿على قلوبهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ربطنا﴾.
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb of past time attached to ﴿ربطنا﴾.
﴿قاموا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿قاموا﴾ is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it.
﴿فقالوا﴾: conjoined to قاموا.
﴿ربنا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿رب السماوات والأرض﴾ khabar (predicate).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future.
﴿ندعو﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by ﴿لن﴾.
﴿من دونه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿إلهًا﴾ and was placed before it.
﴿لقد﴾: the لام is the answer to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq).
﴿قلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إذا﴾: a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal).
﴿شططا﴾: it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a ḥāl from the pronoun of the maṣdar of ﴿قلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿هؤلاء﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿قومنا﴾: a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).
﴿اتخذوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar (predicate).
﴿من دونه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿آلهة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or ﴿هؤلاء﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, ﴿قومنا﴾ is the khabar, and the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is in the accusative position as a ḥāl.
﴿لولا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ).
﴿يأتون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿بسلطان﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتون﴾.
﴿بين﴾: adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فمن أظلم﴾: the فاء is resumptive; من is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and أظلم is its khabar.
﴿ممن افترى﴾: ﴿ممن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أظلم﴾; and the clause ﴿افترى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿على الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿افترى﴾.
﴿كذبا﴾: it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the sense of the maṣdar; and the clause ﴿فمن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وإذ اعتزلتموهم﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (pl.)" (اذكروا); the implied clause ﴿اذكروا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted saying, the implied form being: "and some of them said to others, 'Remember when you withdrew from them'"; and it is said: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فأووا﴾, which is the apodosis; the clause ﴿اعتزلتموهم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; and it is said: ﴿إذ﴾ here is causal (taʿlīliyya).
﴿وما يعبدون إلا الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun conjoined to the هاء, i.e. "you withdrew from them and withdrew from what they worship", or maṣdariyya, the implied form being "you withdrew from them and from their worship"; إلا is a particle of exception, and the Name of Majesty is excepted (mustathnā), connected (muttaṣil) or disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); and it is said: the و is parenthetical, ما is negating, and the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, being a report from Allah about the youths that they did not worship other than Allah.
﴿فأووا إلى الكهف﴾: the فاء occurs in the answer to an implied condition, i.e. "if you wish to be saved with your religion, then take refuge", or "if you have withdrawn from them and what they worship, then take refuge". If ﴿إذ﴾ is conditional, the فاء is in the answer of ﴿إذ﴾; and if it is causal, the فاء marks a consequence (tafrīʿ) of the clause ﴿وإذ اعتزلتموهم﴾. ﴿أووا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى الكهف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أووا﴾.
﴿ينشر﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the answer to the request.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينشر﴾.
﴿ربكم﴾: the fāʿil of ينشر.
﴿من رحمته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of the omitted object of ينشر, i.e. "He will spread out for you success from His mercy" (ينشر لكم نجاحًا من رحمته).
﴿ويهيئ﴾: conjoined to ينشر.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهيئ﴾.
﴿من أمركم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿مرفقًا﴾ and was placed before it.
﴿مرفقًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿وترى﴾: the و is resumptive; ترى is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿الشمس﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿وترى الشمس...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تزاور﴾.
﴿طلعت﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the تاء is for the feminine; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هي), referring to the sun; and the verbal clause is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it.
﴿تزاور﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "it" (هي); the clause ﴿تزاور﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿عن كهفهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تزاور﴾.
﴿ذات اليمين﴾: an adverb of place attached to ﴿تزاور﴾. The conditional clause ﴿إذا طلعت...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الشمس.
﴿وإذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition, attached to ﴿تقرضهم﴾; ﴿غربت﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, the تاء is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هي), referring to the sun; the clause ﴿غربت﴾ is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿تقرضهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "it" (هي), the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi, and the ميم is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿تقرضهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿ذات الشمال﴾ is an adverb of place attached to ﴿تقرضهم﴾; and the clause ﴿إذا غربت تقرضهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إذا طلعت تزاور﴾, so it is in the position of accusative.
﴿وهم في فجوة منه﴾: the و is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في فجوة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); and ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿فجوة﴾.
﴿ذلك من آيات الله﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿من آيات الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿من يهد الله فهو المهتد﴾: من is conditional, in the position of accusative as a fronted object; يهد is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the فاء links the apodosis; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and المهتدي is its khabar.
﴿ومن يضلل فلن تجد له وليا مرشدًا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future; تجد is an imperfect verb in the accusative by ﴿لن﴾; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وليا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿مرشدا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿لن تجد له﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وتحسبهم﴾: the و is resumptive; تحسبهم is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أيقاظًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وهم رقود﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and رقود is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿وتحسبهم أيقاظا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ونقلبهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; نقلبهم is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ذات اليمين﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقلبهم﴾.
﴿وذات الشمال﴾: conjoined to ذات اليمين.
﴿وكلبهم﴾: the و is circumstantial, and كلبهم is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿باسط﴾: khabar.
﴿ذراعيه﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بالوصيد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿باسط﴾; and the clause ﴿كلبهم باسط﴾ is a circumstantial clause.
﴿لو﴾: conditional.
﴿اطلعت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اطلعت﴾.
﴿لوليت﴾: the لام occurs in the answer to لو, and ﴿وليت﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فرارًا﴾.
﴿فرارًا﴾: it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), from the meaning of the verb before it, or it is a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl, i.e. "fleeing" (فارًّا).
﴿لملئت﴾: conjoined to لوليت.
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رعبًا﴾.
﴿رعبًا﴾: a tamyīz (specification), or a second object of ﴿ملئت﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وكذلك بعثناهم ليتساءلوا بينهم﴾: in ﴿كذلك﴾ the كاف is a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); in ﴿ذلك﴾, ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; بعثناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ليتساءلوا the لام is causal, and يتساءلوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بعثناهم﴾; and the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قال قائل منهم كم لبثتم﴾: ﴿قال قائل﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; كم is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb; the accusative specifier (tamyīz) is omitted, its implied form being "how many days" (كم يومًا), as the answer to it indicates; and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿قائل﴾.
﴿قالوا لبثنا يوما أو بعض يوم﴾: ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause لبثنا is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); يومًا is an adverb attached to ﴿لبثنا﴾; أو is a conjunction; and بعض يوم is conjoined to ﴿يومًا﴾.
﴿قالوا ربكم أعلم بما لبثتم﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ربكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is its khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم; and لبثتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فابعثوا أحدكم بورقكم هذه إلى المدينة فلينظر أيها أزكى طعاما﴾: the فاء conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "so leave off the questioning and take up what is more important and more useful to us in this situation of ours, and send"; أحدكم is the mafʿūl bihi; بورقكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ابعثوا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl from أحدكم, the باء being for accompaniment (mulābasa), i.e. "having it with him and accompanied by it"; ﴿هذه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ورقكم﴾; ﴿إلى المدينة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ابعثوا﴾; in ﴿فلينظر﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, the لام is the lām of command, and ينظر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; أيها is interrogative or relative, and it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is أزكى; and طعامًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فليأتكم برزق منه وليتلطف﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; the لام is the lām of command; يأت is jussive by the lām of command, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿برزق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتكم﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿رزق﴾; and وليتلطف is conjoined to فليأتكم.
﴿ولا يشعرن بكم أحدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); يشعرن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive by the prohibitive لا; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يشعرن﴾; and أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿إنهم إن يظهروا عليكم يرجموكم أو يعيدوكم في ملتهم﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿هم﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن; إن is conditional; يظهروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يظهروا﴾; يرجموكم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿أو يعيدوكم﴾ is conjoined to يرجموكم; ﴿في ملتهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعيدوكم﴾; and the clause of the condition and the apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿ولن تفلحوا إذا أبدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future; تفلحوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by ﴿لن﴾, and the و is the fāʿil; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); and أبدًا is an adverb attached to ﴿تفلحوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وكذلك أعثرنا عليهم ليعلموا أن وعد الله حق وأن الساعة لا ريب فيها﴾: in كذلك the كاف is a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); in ﴿ذلك﴾, ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; أعثرنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعثرنا﴾; in ﴿ليعلموا﴾ the لام is causal, and يعلموا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أعثرنا﴾; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of ليعلموا; حق is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿وأن الساعة﴾ is conjoined; لا is the lā of generic negation; ريب is the noun (ism) of لا, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; and the clause of لا with its noun and khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أن.
﴿إذ يتنازعون بينهم أمرهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿أعثرنا﴾; the clause ﴿يتنازعون﴾ is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿بينهم﴾ is an adverb of place attached to ﴿يتنازعون﴾; and أمرهم is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "about their affair" (في أمرهم); and it is said: تنازعوا takes an object when it is in the sense of pulling against one another.
﴿فقالوا ابنوا عليهم بنيانا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿ابنوا﴾ is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and it is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ابنوا﴾; بنيانًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ابنوا عليهم بنيانًا﴾ is the object of their saying.
﴿ربهم أعلم بهم﴾: ﴿ربهم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿أعلم﴾ is the khabar, and ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم.
﴿قال الذين غلبوا على أمرهم لنتخذن عليهم مسجدا﴾: ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿غلبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿على أمرهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿غلبوا﴾; in ﴿لنتخذن﴾ the لام is the lām of the oath, and نتخذن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and مسجدًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿سيقولون ثلاثة رابعهم كلبهم﴾: the سين is for the future; ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ثلاثة﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are three" (هم ثلاثة); ﴿رابعهم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿كلبهم﴾ is a khabar; the clause ﴿هم ثلاثة﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿رابعهم كلبهم﴾ is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ثلاثة﴾.
﴿ويقولون خمسة سادسهم كلبهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿خمسة﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "they are five" (هم خمسة); ﴿سادسهم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿كلبهم﴾ is a khabar; the clause ﴿هم خمسة﴾ is the object of saying; the clause ﴿سادسهم كلبهم﴾ is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of ﴿خمسة﴾; and the clause ﴿ويقولون خمسة﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿رجما بالغيب﴾: ﴿رجمًا﴾ is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by an omitted verb, i.e. "they guess with a guessing" (يرجمون رجمًا), or as a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the sense of "guessing" (راجمين); and ﴿بالغيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رجمًا﴾.
﴿ويقولون سبعة﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿يقولون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿سبعة﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "they are seven" (هم سبعة).
﴿وثامنهم كلبهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿ثامنهم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿كلبهم﴾ is its khabar; and the clause is conjoined to ﴿هم سبعة﴾.
﴿قل ربي أعلم بعدتهم ما يعلمهم إلا قليل﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿ربي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and ﴿أعلم﴾ is its khabar; ﴿بعدتهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم; the clause ﴿ربي أعلم بعدتهم﴾ is the object of saying; the clause ﴿ما يعلمهم...﴾ is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position, or circumstantial; ما is negating; يعلمهم is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and قليل is the fāʿil of يعلمهم.
﴿فلا تمار فيهم إلا مراء ظاهرا﴾: the فاء is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that reveals an omitted condition), i.e. "if you have learned this, and you have every right to know it, then do not dispute"; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿تمار﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; إلا is a particle of restriction; مراء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and ظاهرًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ولا تستفت فيهم منهم أحدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تستفت is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تستفت﴾; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of ﴿أحدًا﴾; and أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿ولا تقولن لشيء إني فاعل ذلك غدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تقولن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive by ﴿لا﴾, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لشيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقولن﴾; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the ياء is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of إن; ﴿فاعل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause ﴿إني فاعل﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ذلك﴾ is the object of ﴿فاعل﴾; and غدًا is an adverb attached to ﴿فاعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿إلا أن يشاء الله﴾: an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh); the clause ﴿أن يشاء الله﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: "Do not say, 'I will do it tomorrow,' except while saying, 'If Allah wills.'" And it is said: the implied form is "except by Allah's willing" (إلا بأن يشاء الله), so the maṣdar ﴿أن يشاء الله﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "except accompanied by saying: If Allah wills." And it is said: the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), and the position of ﴿أن يشاء الله﴾ is accusative as an exception.
﴿واذكر ربك إذا نسيت وقل عسى أن يهدين ربي لأقرب من هذا رشدا﴾: ﴿واذكر﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; ربك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a muḍāf must be assumed to be omitted, i.e. "the will of your Lord" (مشيئة ربك); إذا is an adverb attached to ﴿اذكر﴾; the clause ﴿نسيت﴾ is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it, and its answer is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then remember" (فاذكر); ﴿قل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اذكر﴾; عسى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur), one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); in ﴿وأن يهديني﴾, أن and what falls within its scope are the khabar (predicate); ربي is the fāʿil (agent) of يهديني; ﴿لأقرب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهديني﴾; ﴿من هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقرب; and رشدًا is a tamyīz (specification), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the sense of the maṣdar, i.e. "guide me with a guidance" (يهديني هداية).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ولبثوا﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿في كهفهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لبثوا﴾.
﴿ثلاثمائة﴾: ﴿ثلاث﴾ is an adverb, and ﴿مائة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿سنين﴾: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to ﴿ثلاثمائة﴾, or a badal (substitute).
﴿وازدادوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿تسعًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. nine years.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قل الله أعلم بما لبثوا﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; and the clause ﴿لبثوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿له غيب السماوات والأرض﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and ﴿غيب السماوات والأرض﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿أبصر به وأسمع﴾: أبصر is a form of wonder (taʿajjub); it is a past verb that has come in the form of the imperative while its meaning is a statement; the باء is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) on the fāʿil (agent), to set the wording right; and أسمع is conjoined to أبصر.
﴿ما لهم من دونه من ولي ولا يشرك في حكمه أحدا﴾: ما is negating; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (redundant) preposition, and ولي is the postponed mubtadaʾ in position; in ﴿ولا﴾ the و is a conjunction and لا is negating; يشرك is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; ﴿في حكمه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يشرك﴾; and أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿واتل ما أوحي إليك من كتاب ربك﴾: the و is a conjunction; اتل is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أوحي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحي﴾; and ﴿من كتاب ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿ما﴾.
﴿لا مبدل لكلماته ولن تجد من دونه ملتحدا﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; ﴿مبدل﴾ is its noun (ism), indeclinable on fatḥa; ﴿لكلماته﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿ولن تجد﴾ is conjoined; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of ﴿تجد﴾; and ﴿ملتحدا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿واصبر نفسك مع الذين يدعون ربهم بالغداة والعشي يريدون وجهه﴾: the و is a conjunction; اصبر is a conjoined imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); نفسك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿مع الذين﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصبر﴾; the clause ﴿يدعون ربهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ربهم is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بالغداة والعشي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعون﴾; and the clause ﴿يريدون وجهه﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا تعد عيناك عنهم تريد زينة الحياة الدنيا﴾: conjoined to ﴿واصبر﴾; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿تعد﴾ is jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; عيناك is the fāʿil; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعد﴾; the clause ﴿تريد زينة الحياة الدنيا﴾ is a ḥāl; and الدنيا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ولا تطع من أغفلنا قلبه عن ذكرنا واتبع هواه﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تطع is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, and the fāʿil is latent; مَن is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أغفلنا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; قلبه is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عن ذكرنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أغفلنا﴾; and ﴿اتبع هواه﴾ is a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وكان أمره فرطا﴾: the و is a conjunction; كان is a defective past verb; أمره is the noun (ism) of كان, and فرطا is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وقل الحق من ربكم﴾: الحق is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من ربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); or الحق is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿من ربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿فمن شاء فليؤمن﴾: the فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; مَن is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; شاء is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the فاء links the apodosis; the لام is the lām of command; and يؤمن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command.
﴿ومن شاء فليكفر﴾: the و is a conjunction; من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; شاء is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the فاء links the apodosis; the لام is the lām of command; يكفر is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command; and the clause is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿إنا أعتدنا للظالمين نارا أحاط بهم سرادقها﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن, and the clause ﴿أعتدنا﴾ is the khabar of إن; للظالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعتدنا﴾; نارًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿أحاط بهم سرادقها﴾ the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نارا﴾; أحاط is a past verb; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحاط﴾; and سرادقها is the fāʿil of أحاط.
﴿وإن يستغيثوا يغاثوا بماء كالمهل يشوي الوجوه﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يستغيثوا is the protasis, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil; يغاثوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿بماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغاثوا﴾; in ﴿كالمهل﴾ the كاف is a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of genitive as an adjective of ﴿ماء﴾, and ﴿المهل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يشوي الوجوه﴾ is a second adjective or a ḥāl; and الوجوه is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بئس الشراب وساءت مرتفقا﴾: بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, one of the verbs of blame; الشراب is the fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "it" (هي); ساءت is conjoined to بئس; and مرتفقًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, i.e. "and evil is its resting-place" (وساء مرتفقها).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and الذين is the noun (ism) of إن; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا.
﴿إنا لا نضيع أجر من أحسن عملا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; ﴿نا﴾ is the noun of إن; the clause ﴿لا نضيع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the fāʿil (agent) of نضيع is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); أجر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿إنا لا نضيع﴾ is the khabar of ﴿إن الذين...﴾, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, the implied form being "whoever does good deeds among them" (من أحسن عملا منهم). Or it is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿أولئك لهم جنات﴾ is the khabar; and it is said: the two clauses ﴿إنا لا نضيع﴾ and ﴿أولئك لهم جنات﴾ are two predicates of ﴿إن الذين...﴾. مَن is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿أحسن﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and عملًا is a tamyīz (specification) or a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿أولئك لهم جنات عدن تجري من تحتهم الأنهار﴾: the clause is a second khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن الذين...﴾, or the khabar if the clause ﴿إنا لا نضيع...﴾ is taken as parenthetical. أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لهم﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar, and جنات عدن is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the second mubtadaʾ and its khabar are the khabar of أولئك; and the clause ﴿تجري من تحتهم الأنهار﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب﴾: يحلون is an imperfect verb constructed for that whose agent is not named (passive); the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "while they are in Paradise", or attached to ﴿يحلون﴾; ﴿من أساور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "they will be adorned therein with ornaments arising from bracelets made of gold" (يحلَّون فيها حليًّا ناشئًا من أساور كائنةٍ من ذهب); ﴿من ذهب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أساور﴾; and the clause ﴿يحلون﴾ is a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿لهم﴾.
﴿ويلبسون ثيابا خضرا من سندس وإستبرق متكئين فيها على الأرائك﴾: the و is a conjunction; يلبسون is conjoined to يحلون, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ثيابًا is the mafʿūl bihi, and خضرًا is an adjective; ﴿من سندس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective, or a ḥāl, from ﴿ثيابًا﴾; إستبرق is conjoined to سندس; متكئين is a ḥāl from أولئك; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, likewise attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿على الأرائك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متكئين﴾.
﴿نعم الثواب وحسنت مرتفقا﴾: نعم is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, one of the verbs of praise; الثواب is the fāʿil; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bil-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "it" (هي); حسنت is conjoined to نعم; and مرتفقًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, i.e. "and good is its resting-place" (وحسن مرتفقها).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿واضرب لهم مثلا رجلين﴾: اضرب is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اضرب﴾; مثلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رجلين is a badal (substitute) for ﴿مثلًا﴾, so that ﴿لهم﴾ is in the status of the second object and ﴿مثلًا﴾ is the first object; or ﴿رجلين﴾ is the second object.
﴿جعلنا لأحدهما جنتين من أعناب وحففناهما بنخل﴾: the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رجلين﴾; ﴿لأحدهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; جنتين is the first object; ﴿من أعناب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿جنتين﴾; حففناهما is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, conjoined to جعلنا; and ﴿بنخل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حففناهما﴾.
﴿وجعلنا بينهما زرعا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿جعلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted second object of ﴿جعلنا﴾; and زرعا is the first object.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿كلتا الجنتين آتت أكلها ولم تظلم منه شيئا﴾: كلتا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif because it is a noun ending in a short alif (ism maqṣūr); the clause ﴿آتت أكلها﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كلتا; لم تظلم is conjoined to آتت; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تظلم﴾; and شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وفجرنا خلالهما نهرا﴾: فجرنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); خلالهما is an adverb attached to ﴿فجرنا﴾; and نهرًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وكان له ثمر فقال لصاحبه وهو يحاوره﴾: the و is a conjunction; كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; ﴿له﴾ is the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, and ثمر is its postponed noun (ism); ﴿فقال﴾ is conjoined to ﴿كان﴾; ﴿لصاحبه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the و is circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يحاوره is the khabar; and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿أنا أكثر منك مالا وأعز نفرا﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and أكثر is the khabar; ﴿منك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أكثر﴾; مالًا is a tamyīz (specification); and ﴿وأعز نفرًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أكثر مالًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿ودخل جنته﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهو ظالم لنفسه﴾: the و is circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ظالم is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); and ﴿لنفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ظالم﴾.
﴿قال ما أظن أن تبيد هذه أبدا﴾: قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿ما أظن...﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of أظن; ﴿هذه﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿تبيد﴾; and أبدًا is an adverb of time attached to ﴿تبيد﴾.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وما أظن الساعة قائمة﴾: ﴿وما أظن﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿ما أظن﴾; الساعة is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and قائمة is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولئن رددت إلى ربي﴾: the و is a conjunction; the لام paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; رددت is a past verb constructed for that whose agent is not named (passive), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the تاء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿لأجدن خيرا منها منقلبا﴾: the لام occurs in the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the answer to the oath indicating it; خيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أجدن﴾; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خيرًا﴾; and منقلبًا is a tamyīz (specification); or ﴿خيرًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) and ﴿منقلبًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "I will surely find a return better than it" (لأجدن منقلبًا خيرًا منها).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿قال له صاحبه وهو يحاوره أكفرت بالذي خلقك من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم سواك رجلا﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; ﴿صاحبه﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the و is circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يحاوره is the khabar (predicate); the hamza is interrogative; كفرت is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بالذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفرت﴾; the clause خلقك is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿من تراب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقك﴾; ﴿ثم من نطفة﴾ is conjoined; ثم is a conjunction; ﴿سواك﴾ is a past verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿رجلًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second object of ﴿سواك﴾; and it is said: a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿لكنا هو الله ربي﴾: ﴿لكنا﴾ is originally لكن أنا; ﴿لكن﴾ is for rectification (istidrāk); ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هو﴾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿الله﴾ is a third mubtadaʾ; ﴿ربي﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the ياء refers back to the first mubtadaʾ; or ﴿الله﴾ is a badal (substitute) for ﴿هو﴾.
﴿ولا أشرك بربي أحدا﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is negating; أشرك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); ﴿بربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أشرك﴾; and أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ولولا إذ دخلت جنتك قلت ما شاء الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. "why not" (هلا); إذ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلت﴾; the clause ﴿دخلت﴾ is in the position of genitive, the adverb being annexed to it; ﴿ما﴾ is relative, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is what Allah has willed" (هذا الذي شاءه الله); or ﴿ما﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "came to be" (كان); and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿شاء الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, as we have assumed; or ﴿ما﴾ is conditional, its position being accusative by the protasis verb (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, i.e. "it came to be" (كان), the meaning being: "whatever Allah willed came to be"; and the whole clause is the object of saying.
﴿لا قوة إلا بالله﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation; قوة is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿لا﴾.
﴿إن ترن أنا أقل منك مالا وولدا﴾: إن is conditional; ترنِ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the omitted ياء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أنا﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and أقل is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ترنِ﴾; or ﴿أنا﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the ياء; ﴿منك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أقل﴾; مالًا is a tamyīz (specification), and ولدًا is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿فعسى ربي أن يؤتين خيرا من جنتك﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿ربي﴾ is the noun (ism) of عسى; أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative as its khabar (predicate); خيرًا is the second object of ﴿يؤتيني﴾; and ﴿من جنتك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خيرا﴾.
﴿ويرسل عليها حسبانا من السماء فتصبح صعيدا زلقا﴾: the و is a conjunction; يرسل is conjoined to يؤتيني, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); ﴿عليها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾; حسبانًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حسبانا﴾; in ﴿فتصبح﴾ the فاء conjoins to what preceded, and تصبح is an imperfect verb in the accusative because it is conjoined to what preceded; the noun of تصبح is latent, its implied form being "it" (هي); صعيدًا is the khabar of تصبح; and زلقًا is a naʿt of ﴿صعيدًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿أو يصبح ماؤها غورا فلن تستطيع له طلبا﴾: أو is a conjunction; يصبح is an imperfect verb in the accusative, conjoined to what precedes it; ماؤها is the noun (ism) of يصبح, and غورًا is its khabar (predicate); the فاء is a conjunction; لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future; تستطيع is accusative by ﴿لن﴾, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿طلبًا﴾; and طلبًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وأحيط بثمره فأصبح يقلب كفيه على ما أنفق فيها﴾: the و is resumptive; أحيط is a past verb constructed for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿بثمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحيط﴾; the clause ﴿وأحيط بثمره﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; أصبح is a defective past verb, its noun (ism) latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause يقلب كفيه is the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; and ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقلب﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "he wrung his hands, regretting what he had spent on it" (يقلب كفيه نادمًا على ما أنفق فيها).
﴿وهي خاوية على عروشها ويقول يا ليتني لم أشرك بربي أحدا﴾: the و is circumstantial; ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and خاوية is the khabar; ﴿على عروشها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خاوية; ﴿يقول﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يقلب﴾, or the و is circumstantial and the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of يقلب; يا is for calling attention (tanbīh) or for the vocative, the one addressed being omitted; ليت is a particle of wishing (tamannī) that puts the noun in the accusative and the khabar in the nominative; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the ياء is its noun; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (qalb) and of the jussive; أشرك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; ﴿بربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشرك﴾; أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿يا ليتني لم أشرك﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿ولم تكن له فئة ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان منتصرا﴾: the و is for conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (qalb) and of the jussive; تكن is a defective imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of تكن; فئة is the postponed noun (ism) of تكن; the clause ينصرونه is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿فئة﴾; ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective past verb, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); and منتصرًا is the khabar of كان. [Translator's note: the source reads «خبر خبر كان», with the word خبر repeated, evidently a typographical duplication; translated as "the khabar of كان".]
